delta_focus: 7 gap-fix files from EXC-002 — correctness/accessibility/maintainability of TASK-001 through TASK-004

findings.title: Trash2 button aria-hidden on keyboard-focusable element (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.1)
findings.description: When input is empty, the Trash2 clear-draft button has aria-hidden=true but remains keyboard-focusable (pointer-events-none does not affect tab order, tabIndex is not set to -1). Keyboard users can Tab onto a control that assistive technologies cannot describe.
findings.impact: Screen reader users encounter an undescribed focusable element. WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.1 violation.
findings.suggestion: Remove aria-hidden. Add tabIndex={input.length === 0 ? -1 : undefined} to exclude from tab order when hidden. Keep opacity-0 pointer-events-none for visual hiding.

findings.title: Copy success not announced to screen readers (WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3)
findings.description: Changing aria-label in place on button state transition does not reliably trigger screen reader announcements in NVDA or VoiceOver. WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3 requires status updates to be programmatically determinable without requiring focus.
findings.impact: Screen reader users receive no audible confirmation that the clipboard write succeeded.
findings.suggestion: Add {copied ? 'Copied!' : ''} adjacent to the button. Button label can remain static.

findings.title: Non-null assertion on optional lastAssistantContent in copyLastReply
findings.description: lastAssistantContent is typed string | undefined. The button is conditionally rendered at line 123 but the handler itself bypasses the type guard via ! operator. If invoked programmatically without the prop, writeText receives undefined.
findings.impact: Potential runtime TypeError; places string 'undefined' on clipboard in edge cases.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit guard: if (!lastAssistantContent) return; Remove the ! assertion.

findings.title: Draft-restore useEffect may read stale persistedText if useDraftCache effect runs after
findings.description: Both this effect and useDraftCache's internal effect fire on the same render triggered by currentConversationId change. React does not guarantee effect execution order between different hooks in the same commit. If useDraftCache's effect runs after this one, setInput receives the previous conversation's persistedText.
findings.impact: On rapid conversation switch, composer may briefly show (or permanently display) previous conversation's draft.
findings.suggestion: Call load(conversationId) directly inside the effect rather than depending on closure-captured persistedText. This eliminates the inter-effect ordering dependency.

findings.title: clearDraft guard skips when debounce hasn't flushed — sent message persists in cache
findings.description: If a user types and sends within the 350ms debounce window, persistedText state is still '' (debounced persist hasn't flushed yet). clearDraft() is skipped, but the debounce timer fires 350ms later and writes the sent message to localStorage. The draft re-appears on next conversation visit.
findings.impact: Successfully sent messages can reappear as drafts, confusing users into thinking their message wasn't sent.
findings.suggestion: Always call clearDraft() unconditionally on send, and additionally cancel any pending debounce: add a cancel() method to makeDebounce and call debouncedPersist.cancel() before clearDraft().

findings.title: Paperclip upload button missing focus-visible ring (peer buttons updated in gap-fix)
findings.description: The Paperclip file picker button was not updated with focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 classes, while all 3 peer toolbar buttons (BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy) received them in TASK-001. Inconsistent focus ring appearance within the same toolbar.
findings.impact: Keyboard focus ring is visually inconsistent between peer toolbar buttons.
findings.suggestion: Add focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 to the Paperclip button className.

findings.title: Copy feedback setTimeout not cleaned up on component unmount
findings.description: The 1500ms timer is not stored or cleared. If ChatAreaComposer unmounts (user navigates away) before the timer fires, the callback attempts setState on an unmounted component.
findings.impact: Resource leak; timer holds closure reference preventing GC. May cause state update warnings in strict mode.
findings.suggestion: Store timer ID in a ref, clear in useEffect cleanup: useEffect(() => { if (!copied) return; const id = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); return () => clearTimeout(id) }, [copied]).

findings.title: makeDebounce generic utility defined in presentation component module
findings.snippet: function makeDebounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, delay: number) {
findings.description: A generic infrastructure utility is defined inside a presentation component file. Reverses the dependency direction — any future consumer must import from a UI component to use a pure utility.
findings.impact: Cannot be reused without importing from a component module. Violates layer boundaries.
findings.suggestion: Move to src/utils/debounce.ts (or src/utils/index.ts) and import in ChatArea.tsx. Low-effort relocation.

findings.title: makeDebounce uses any[] type constraint bypassing TypeScript safety
findings.description: The generic constraint uses any[] which disables type inference on the returned wrapper's argument types. Incorrect argument types passed to debouncedPersist won't be caught at compile time.
findings.impact: Type safety erosion at debounce call sites.
findings.suggestion: Replace any[] with unknown[]: function makeDebounce<T extends (...args: unknown[]) => void>

findings.title: Magic number 1500ms for copy feedback reset lacks named constant
findings.description: 1500ms is hardcoded in the component and duplicated in the test (line 122). Changing the component value requires manual test update; no named constant communicates the intent.
findings.impact: Hidden coupling between component and test; risk of divergence.
findings.suggestion: Export COPY_FEEDBACK_RESET_MS = 1500 from the component or a constants module; reference in both.

findings.title: Magic number 350ms for draft-persist debounce lacks named constant
findings.description: 350ms debounce delay is an inline literal with no documentation of the UX rationale.
findings.impact: Future developers may change it without realizing it was intentionally tuned.
findings.suggestion: Extract const DRAFT_PERSIST_DEBOUNCE_MS = 350 near the draft lifecycle comment at line 135.

findings.title: vi.stubGlobal('navigator') not restored in tests — pollutes subsequent test suites
findings.description: navigator is replaced entirely (twice, lines 95 and 107) with no afterEach cleanup. Subsequent tests in the same Vitest worker receive a stripped navigator object missing userAgent, permissions, etc.
findings.impact: Risk of hard-to-diagnose flaky failures in unrelated tests.
findings.suggestion: Add afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals()). Or use vi.spyOn(navigator.clipboard, 'writeText') to avoid replacing the full navigator object.

findings.title: Trash2 opacity test asserts not.toHaveClass('opacity-0') but not toHaveClass('opacity-100')
findings.description: Absence of opacity-0 leaves the positive assertion incomplete. A refactor removing both opacity classes would leave the element invisible but the test would still pass.
findings.impact: False confidence in Trash2 visibility regression coverage.
findings.suggestion: Add expect(button).toHaveClass('opacity-100') alongside the existing not.toHaveClass('opacity-0').

findings.title: makeDebounce lacks cancel method — pending timer not cleared on useMemo re-run
findings.description: If persist identity changes, useMemo creates a new debounced function. The pending timer from the previous one is silently abandoned — it will fire later on the stale persist reference, potentially writing to the wrong cache key.
findings.impact: Edge-case stale draft write after conversation switch (if persist is ever recreated).
findings.suggestion: Add a cancel() method to makeDebounce. In useEffect cleanup: () => debouncedPersist.cancel?.()

findings.title: ChatAreaComposer owns clipboard side-effect and copied state
findings.description: A presentational composer component owns clipboard side-effect logic and timeout state. The copy action is driven by lastAssistantContent from the parent, which already has the necessary context.
findings.impact: Clipboard logic not independently testable; couples composer to message model.
findings.suggestion: Lift to useCopyToClipboard hook or pass onCopyLastReply callback from ChatArea.

findings.title: AppContextFooter renders dynamic text without ARIA live region
findings.description: Dynamic context usage text (e.g., '~2K tokens') updates as user types but has no role='status' or aria-live announcement. Screen reader users cannot monitor resource usage.
findings.impact: Dynamic updates not announced; inferior experience for assistive technology users.
findings.suggestion: Add role='status' aria-live='polite' aria-atomic='true' to the div.

findings.title: AppContextFooter.test.tsx missing whitespace-only string edge case for trim() branch
findings.description: The component guards with !contextEstimatedText.trim() but only the empty string case is tested. A whitespace-only string ('   ') also returns null but is untested.
findings.impact: Partial branch coverage on null-render logic.
findings.suggestion: Add test: render(<AppContextFooter contextEstimatedText="   " />) and assert null render.

findings.title: BookmarkPlus focus ring may conflict with global *:focus-visible box-shadow rule
findings.description: globals.css applies outline + box-shadow via *:focus-visible. The Tailwind focus-visible:outline-none suppresses outline but not the global box-shadow, potentially creating a double-ring in some browsers.
findings.impact: Inconsistent keyboard focus appearance in some browser/OS combinations.
findings.suggestion: Add focus-visible:shadow-none to suppress the global box-shadow when the Tailwind ring is active, or consolidate to one approach globally.
